description:
Welcome to Part 1 of our full walkthrough of the Homeland54!

In this video, we're taking you through the areas that matter most, the spacious living room, beautiful kitchen, and relaxing master suite. The Homeland54 has quickly become one of our most popular floor plans thanks to its smart design, open layout, and family friendly features.

Be sure to subscribe and watch Part 2, where we'll show you the spare bedrooms, additional bathroom, and the rest of this incredible home.

Thinking about upgrading your living situation? The Homeland54 might be exactly what you've been looking for!
☎️ (325)676-9700
📍 3301 Hickory St., Abilene, Tx
